To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) strategic planning is positively related to social and operational outcomes; 2) strategic planning is more effective in stable and simple environments; 3) the effect of planning is stronger in larger companies; 4) the effect of strategic planning is stronger in companies with more formalized planning systems; 5) the effect of environmental uncertainty is moderated by strategic planning; 6) the effect of complexity is mediated by strategic planning.

1) The environment does not influence the outcome of strategic planning; 2) The social outcomes of strategic planning are negative; 3) Strategic planning is not a determinant of operational performance.

1. Strategic planning has a positive influence on social outcomes, i.e. organizational performance, and operational outcomes, i.e., organizational learning, and 2. The influence of strategic planning on social outcomes is stronger when the business environment is more complex.
